prompts.TOP3: The 16 images are frames from 16 consecutive segments of one video, in time order (Segment 1 to Segment 16). Which 3 segments are the most important highlights of this video? Answer with only the 3 segment numbers, most important first, separated by commas.
prompts.RATE: The 16 images are frames from 16 consecutive segments of one video, in time order (Segment 1 to Segment 16). Rate how much each segment is a highlight of this video from 0 (boring) to 9 (key highlight). Answer with exactly 16 integers separated by commas, one per segment in order.
prompts.SINGLE: This is one frame from a video. Rate how likely this moment is a highlight of the video, from 0 (boring) to 9 (key highlight). Answer with one integer only.
prompts.COUNT: How many images are shown above? Answer with one integer only.
prompts.MATCH: The first 16 images are Segment 1 to Segment 16 of a video. The last image is an exact copy of one of those segments. Which segment number is it? Answer with one integer only.
